text:
molly (AE): Hey finance — need an exception for AuroraMetrics. Their migration hit a blocker and onboarding stretched by 3 weeks. Sales recommends a one-off onboarding credit + a 30d trial extension to reduce churn risk.
raj (sales-ops): Context: mid-market account, expected ARR ramp $18k -> $50k in 6 months. Risk of churn if we don't remedy.
jena (finance): Please provide proposed credit amount and expected impact. Also call out who signs on exceptions >$2k per policy.
molly (AE): Proposed: 45% credit on first invoice (~$4.5k invoice) => credit ~$2,025 and extend trial 30 days (delays revenue). Short-term impact approx $2k, long-term retention improvement expected.
elliot (revops): Modeling quick: if ramp reaches $50k ARR, the credit is small vs lifetime value. Suggest we add a usage gate to avoid abuse.
jena (finance): Under current finance policy I can approve up to $2,000. Anything above requires VP sign-off.
molly (AE): Can we round to $2,000? That keeps within your approval and is easy in the contract.
raj (sales-ops): Migration ticket: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/ONB-734 (copied). Will add notes to amendment referencing ticket resolution.
dealbot: Approval request logged: DR-1983 (status: pending).
jena (finance): If you accept $2,000 + 30d trial I can approve now. Condition: credit applied only after onboarding ticket marked resolved and customer passes a minimal usage threshold (e.g., >=10k tokens/day or equivalent activity) during the extension period. Also document this as one-off non-recurring credit; do not change list prices.
molly (AE): I'll update the amendment to include the usage threshold and ticket reference.
raj (sales-ops): I'll draft the amendment. PO flow: once signed, finance applies credit on next invoice.
molly (AE): Thanks. tagging for visibility: @jena approved if we do $2,000, @raj to prepare doc. :white_check_mark:
dealbot: DR-1983 updated: credit set to $2,000, conditions added, finance approved. Internal note: one-off customer success credit, thresholded.
